text: The lime does the work: it dissolves the casein into a glue and, as it reacts, makes the dried film resist water. Adjusting the balance of sodium hydroxide and lime trades water resistance against pot life. Alkali dissolves the casein, so no cooking is needed.

steps.note: 100 parts casein, ground to pass a 20-mesh sieve, in 150 parts water.
Sodium hydroxide, 11 parts in 50 parts water.
Hydrated lime, 20 parts in 50 parts water.
